description: This file defines the TreeFactory class responsible for managing and retrieving ModelTree objects from XML resources within the OFBiz framework's widget module.

classes.name: TreeFactory
classes.description: Factory class for loading and retrieving ModelTree instances from XML resource files, including caching mechanisms.

methods.name: getTreeFromLocation
methods.description: Loads and retrieves a ModelTree object given a resource name and tree name, utilizing caching for performance.

methods.name: readTreeDocument
methods.description: Parses an XML Document to extract ModelTree elements and returns a map of ModelTree objects.
